$comment: Mapping used by the figma-sync agent. This Figma file is COMPONENT-FIRST: reusable UI lives as local Figma components on the '💠 Components' page (componentsPage below), and screens are ASSEMBLIES OF INSTANCES of those components — never duplicated raw layers. When an app element is reused, the agent reuses (or creates) a component on that page, then instances it. node ids use the ':' form (384:80); the URL uses '384-80'. knownComponents is a HINT captured on 2026-07-10 — the live page (get_metadata 384:80) is always the source of truth.

componentsPage.name: 💠 Components
componentsPage.$comment: Home of every reusable local component. Place a NEW component in the section matching its kind. ALWAYS reuse an existing component (match by name) before creating a duplicate.

framesComment: The 4 maintained SCREEN frames the user assigned (2026-07-10). These are full 1440-wide screen assemblies on the Flows/Screens page — distinct from the mockups on the '💠 Components' page (e.g. the 'Session — Central thread' assembly 618:759 there is NOT the maintained session; 643:4812 is). Each is an assembly of component instances — sync by (re)instancing components per the isolation rules, never by editing raw layers. Verified each node id against the live file.

contexts.name: Playbooks
contexts.note: Playbooks LIST page (Sidebar + Topbar + Playbook Card instances + ghost 'Create a Playbook' card).

playbook.name: Playbook detail
playbook.note: Playbook DETAIL page (Sidebar + Topbar + rail + Recap Panel components).

session.name: Session
session.note: Main chat surface — largest screen. Also touches src/screens/session/*, chat.css.

session-new-chat.name: Session — New chat
session-new-chat.note: First-run empty hero (renderEmptyHero): Sidebar (Expanded) + Topbar (title 'New chat', Sources/Ideas/Drafts counters 0) + centered hero = Archie wordmark (brand SVG) + subtitle + Composer Card instance + 'Or jump into a workflow' label + starter-grid of 3 'Starter Card' instances (Batch/mermaid, Video clips/purple, Top posts/green). Starter Card is a LOCAL hand-built component (no DS 'workflow card') with Title/Subtitle/CTA text props + Art INSTANCE_SWAP; watermarks are V2 Icons.

top-posts-board.name: Top Posts — Board
top-posts-board.note: Winner-selection board rendered in the assistant thread: intro Chat — AI Message + toolbar (count + Period/Sort filters) + wrapping grid of Top Post Card instances (carousel/image/text formats, set 1169:1687 / 1205:1666 / 1206:1677). FLAG: the Period/Sort filters use DS stroked-grey Buttons with a chevron as a DS-clean stand-in for the app's custom .ap-select inline dropdown (no DS Figma equivalent).

connectors.name: Connectors
connectors.note: Connectors gallery. Full assembly: Sidebar + Topbar (title 'Connectors') + hero (title/subtitle + DS Status count pill) + toolbar (DS Form-Search + DS Tag category chips) + 6 category groups of 'Connector Card' instances (set 1233:2255; State=Default/Connected). Logos use accent monogram tiles (code fallback), not brand SVGs. Detail/empty/mobile not built. Feature gated behind the `connectors` flag (OFF by default) in the app.
